shipped_rows.title_o: An Experimental Test of the Expectancy-Disconfirmation Theory of Citizen Satisfaction

blind_target.evidence_quote: Van Ryzin experimentally manipulated expectations and performance and found a direct effect of performance, but no disconfirmation. We performed: an exact replication; a conceptual replication with extreme manipulations; a conceptual replication that reversed the order of a performance and expectations manipulation.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Study 1 and 2 reproduced original findings. In contrast, study 3 indicates that expectation cues are retrospectively used to anchor prior experiences of performance.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Two replications agree, while the third is explicitly contrasted. Original bibliographic entry unavailable in abstract.
